theory: The inflection description gives the same bending transition at both points: moving left to right, the left point changes from bending upwards to bending downwards, while the right point reverses that change. Describe an inflection point as a change in concavity, and qualify the context criterion as supporting an approximate normal model rather than guaranteeing one.
summary: Replaced unsupported inflection calculations, parameter-only comparisons and context-only normality questions with cited booklet drawing, graphical comparison and histogram tasks, preserving all quiz ids and unaffected items. Corrected the theory's concavity and approximate-model wording, marked the supplied area calculation as approximate, and repaired the whole-area distractor explanation; no whole items were removed.
